name: Guildhall Square
status: New combined direction for review; concept only.

references.role: D: primary square and power beacon
C: guild hall architecture only; remove the terraces
Approved workshop exterior: style, scale and physical adjacency

prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept / compositing from existing concept references.
Asset type: ONE polished landscape game environment concept, 1536x1024, full bleed, one coherent scene.

Input image roles:
IMAGE 1 (D, Lantern Exchange) is the PRIMARY basis: retain its warm inhabited medium-city square, municipal amber root-power beacon, cream/ochre/salmon plaster and limestone, teal shutters, clay/copper roofs, fine brown outlines and painterly chunky game architecture.
IMAGE 2 (C, Terraced Exchange) supplies ONLY THE GUILD HALL BUILDING at its upper rear: the grand cream civic building with the pediment clock, big arched public doorway, teal/gold banners and patinated copper roof. Bring that building down onto the SAME WALKABLE LEVEL as the new square. It should be a prominent, substantial 3-to-4-storey guild hall with its full roof and entrance visible. Do not copy C's terraced square, rotunda, raised galleries, giant staircases or stacked walkable levels.
IMAGE 3 is the APPROVED ORIGINAL WORKSHOP EXTERIOR. Match its architectural identity, fine outlined materials, natural detailing and everyday scale, and keep that workshop physically adjacent.

PRIMARY REQUEST:
Combine D's city-centre square and monumental power beacon with C's attractive guild hall in one NEW composition, but give the square a little more openness and a varied background. This is a civic / trading hub where future quests are handed in and money is introduced, and a place the player will later build in and change. Preserve the warmth and amount of detail; make it less cramped and easier to extend.

LAYOUT / GAMEPLAY READABILITY:
One coherent, MAINLY FLAT COBBLED PLAZA. All principal public doors, shops, guild counter and the power source are on this shared walkable grade. Ordinary two or three shallow doorstep treads are fine; no upper/lower plazas, overpasses, tall platforms, steep terraced market or criss-crossing stairs.
Keep D's impressive large enclosed amber ROOT-POWER LANTERN as the unmistakable focal point near the middle: stone service base with an oversized readable pressure dial, living roots surrounding a large warm amber core inside clear glass, sturdy cream/teal/copper pillars and a patinated copper cap. It is several people high, an intentional city landmark; no miniature garden well and no mystical crystal spire. The heart is visibly enclosed and cared for, and inset brass supply branches run into the paving. Leave a genuinely generous clear walkable ring around it and a broad uncluttered approach in the foreground.
The GUILD HALL is the second major landmark and the obvious quest destination. Its generous arched doorway and public notice board / ticket counter face the open plaza, visibly reached without detouring behind the power source. Use the handsome facade and clock-pediment character from C rather than D's smaller coin-logo arcade.
A merchants' exchange or savings counter with a restrained coin emblem, a parcel/post office, and a few varied stocked shops address the same square. Several three-to-five-storey buildings remain substantial and attached, preserving the medium-sized city identity. Commercial detail sits along the edges rather than filling every walking route with stalls.

OPENNESS / VARIED BACKGROUND:
Open D's continuous ring of near-identical tall facades. Make an intentionally varied silhouette: the guild hall mass; one group of taller attached merchant houses; a smaller workshop/courier service frontage; and one breathing gap with a leafy shade tree and a LOW HARBOUR OVERLOOK WALL through which distant roofs and a little sea are visible. Two clear side streets continue into further city blocks. This is still an urban square, not a suburban garden or village green.
Keep one generous side apron/edge of the plaza relatively free of permanent objects: ordinary irregular paving, a modest planted/unpaved verge and low masonry edge that look natural now but suggest space for the player's later building and alterations. A movable handcart or a neat stack of spare timber can sit at its far edge. No visible building grid, editor markers, empty labelled plots or construction-site barricades.
Ground and architecture stay rich with believable small detail, but leave noticeably more unoccupied pavement and more sky/gaps between the main background masses than D. Avoid making the square twice as large and desolate. Avoid a full foreground roof hiding the playable space.

CONTINUITY:
Show Nell's recognisable cream half-timbered workshop with green double doors, terracotta roof and round gable window just along an adjoining short street at the back/side of the square, clearly in this same connected block. Use a mild street slope or a single short stair if needed outside the main plaza, not a long journey or a separate distant hill. It should be obvious how a player walks from the workshop exterior to this square.

STYLE / LIFE:
Elevated three-quarter orthographic-like game camera, one readable overall environment composition, generously framed so the main landmarks fit. Warm daylight, soft blue-grey shade, painterly plaster and stone, bevelled wood/metal, sepia outlines, green shutters, terracotta roof tiles, restrained copper/brass. It should look like a more detailed continuation of the approved workshop scene.
Lived-in upper windows, a little washing, stocked perimeter stalls, useful carts, flower boxes, supported awnings and wires, drainage grilles, worn thresholds and a few residents. Cute cream-and-teal worker robots use WHEELS; a tiny red-haired teen/young-adult traveller in teal and Hotaru can establish scale. Make people and doors consistent: taller buildings have more floors, not giant doorways dwarfing child-sized people. A few plants add relief without turning the urban square into a park.
No HUD, labels, title, watermark, diagram arrows, text explanation, floating island border, neon, steampunk gear clutter, cathedral/castle grandeur, giant tree crown, magical particles, or multiple images. One refined NEW hybrid concept.
